Interface Motor

All Known Subinterfaces:
RegulatedMotor
public interface Motor
A basic motor that can be driven by power. Implementations are supplied by a motor controller or board facade; the interface itself contains only primitive operations, so a motor handle can be used without allocating in the board program.

Power is expressed as a magnitude from 0 to 100 percent of the controller's available power. Implementations clamp values outside that range; direction is selected with forward() or backward().
